summary.headline: Uno Minda Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue rose 26% YoY to INR 5,557 crores; EBITDA margin 10.3%, with FY27 guidance of 11% ±50 bps held.
summary.overview: Consolidated revenue from operations hit a record INR 5,557 crores, up 26% YoY against INR 4,420 crores excluding prior-period income. EBITDA excluding prior-year exceptional income grew 21% to INR 572 crores, but margin was 10.3% as commodity and gas inflation, a ~40 bps mathematical pass-through dilution and minimum wage hikes weighed on it. Management kept the annual EBITDA margin guidance of 11% ±50 bps, biased to the upper end. PAT attributable to shareholders rose 24% to INR 296 crores, and the company added seating, sunroof and lighting orders while the Inovance JV awaits China approval.

segments.name: Switching systems
segments.commentary: Revenue INR 1,335 crores, +20% YoY, 24% of consolidated turnover. 4-wheeler switches under Uno Mindarika grew 24% to INR 525 crores; Manesar to Farrukhnagar shift on track for H2 FY27.

segments.name: Lighting systems
segments.commentary: Revenue INR 1,153 crores, +14% YoY, ~21% of revenue. New domestic 4-wheeler lighting nomination from a global OEM; INR 450 crores annual peak value order in 2W lighting; Indonesia 4W lighting plant secured a second customer with SOP in Q2 FY28.

segments.name: Casting
segments.commentary: Revenue INR 1,090 crores, +32% YoY, ~20% of revenue and the fastest-growing vertical. 2W alloy wheel INR 284 crores, 4W alloy wheel INR 56 crores, aluminium die casting INR 248 crores (+66%).

segments.name: Seating systems
segments.commentary: Revenue INR 408 crores, +28% YoY, ~7% of revenue. Exports INR 72 crores; INR 390 crores annual peak export orders from 3 new customers; INR 320 crores greenfield 4W seating plant at Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, operations by Q2 FY28.

segments.name: Green mobility
segments.commentary: Revenue INR 542 crores, +78% YoY, ~10% of revenue. Alternate fuels INR 184 crores, Uno Minda EV Systems INR 186 crores, Uno Minda Automation INR 123 crores, EV controller business INR 37 crores. Like-for-like EV EV Systems plus controller revenue INR 218 crores, +24%.

segments.name: Other (reconfigured)
segments.commentary: Revenue INR 1,029 crores, +21% YoY, ~19% of revenue. Sensors and ADAS INR 250 crores, acoustics INR 225 crores, blow moulding INR 125 crores, non-EV controllers INR 80 crores; sunroof order book crossed INR 500 crores.

segments.name: Aftermarket and SPD
segments.commentary: Aftermarket revenue INR 336 crores (~6%); OEM spare parts division INR 254 crores; combined INR 590 crores, ~11% of consolidated revenue.

guidance_outlook: Annual EBITDA margin guidance of 11% ±50 bps, with a bias towards the higher end, reaffirmed despite Q1 headwinds.

FY27 capex stays at about INR 1,750 crores. Total announced project capex is about INR 3,800 crores, of which about INR 1,400 crores is spent; the remaining ~INR 2,000 crores to be spent over 18-24 months.
Gross margin may stay under pressure from commodity pass-through dilution (~40 bps) and lower-margin electronics business, but EBITDA margin should offset this.
Management expects healthy automotive growth through the rest of FY27 and aims to keep outperforming industry volumes.
Export targets: double and triple export value in absolute terms, with export growth needing to outpace domestic growth to raise its share.
Inovance JV: no holdup on plant construction or supplies as of now; more clarity expected in about one quarter.
capex_capacity: Kharkhoda 4W alloy wheel: new 60,000-unit line to be fully ramped up from Q2 FY27; a further 30,000-unit line to commission in H2 FY27.
Bawal 2W alloy wheel: 4 of 6 lines expected live in H2 FY27, adding about 1 million units annual capacity and entering HPDC alloy wheels.
Sunroof plant commissioning by end FY27; ramp in FY27 with full sales from FY28-FY29. Order book above INR 500 crores.
4W seating greenfield plant at Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (INR 320 crores): commencement by Q2 FY28; capex of INR 3.2 billion can generate more than 2x its investment in revenue.
Lighting: consolidation of North India 2W lighting plants into Kharkhoda from H2 FY27; Indonesia lighting plant transition to new facility by end FY27.
Inovance JV plants: Khed City plant construction on schedule; CSN plant to start construction in the next couple of months.
demand_pricing: Indian automotive production in Q1 FY27 was a record 96.9 lakh units (+22% YoY); PV production 14.5 lakh (+17%); 2W 72.5 lakh (+23%); CV 2.9 lakh (+15%).
EV penetration in PV reached 6.8% (84,000 units, +54%); electric 2W registrations crossed 5 lakh in a quarter; electric 3W penetration above 60%.
Customers are passing through commodity costs, with some OEMs moving to monthly price adjustments on one or two commodities and some announcing price hikes.
Seating kit value estimated at INR 30,000-40,000 per car; management says it could become one of the group's largest kit-value products.
Competition in Indian seating is intense; the Tachi-S partnership is cited as a technology edge.

qa_highlights.question: How will the company compete in 4W seating (segments, market size) and how will H2 growth hold up against a high base, including Inovance SOPs?
qa_highlights.answer: Management has one 4W seating nomination with more models in talks and will not name vehicles before launch; kit value is INR 30,000-40,000 per car. As of now there is no holdup to Inovance products or plant work, and the H2 growth is supported by Kharkhoda phase 2, 2W alloy wheels and the Mindarika move.

qa_highlights.question: Is green mobility near group profitability, and what is the capex plan for FY27 and FY28?
qa_highlights.answer: Some green mobility businesses already earn above group profitability while newer ones are below it; new businesses are expected to reach target profitability in their third full year of production. FY27 capex remains about INR 1,750 crores; FY28 guidance will be given with the annual outlook.

qa_highlights.question: How fast will margins recover toward 11%, and can wage and commodity costs be passed through?
qa_highlights.answer: The ~40 bps commodity dilution persists for the rest of FY27 if prices stay high. Management expects to absorb much of the wage increase through automation and productivity and to recover commodities on a quarterly or half-yearly basis, with some customers moving to monthly indexation.

qa_highlights.question: Why did depreciation fall QoQ in Q1?
qa_highlights.answer: Casting uses the WDV method, so new capacity starts from a lower base and Q1 depreciation tends to be lower than Q4.

qa_highlights.question: What is the revenue potential of the 4W seating capex and the timing of export and sunroof ramps?
qa_highlights.answer: The INR 3.2 billion seating capex can generate more than 2x revenue. Export orders run on a 2-year cycle, with impact from end FY28 and full run-rate in FY29; the sunroof ramp starts around March-April 2027.

qa_highlights.question: What is the status of the China Inovance JV and is e-axle import at risk?
qa_highlights.answer: Press Note 3 approval is in hand, but China approval is pending after recent regulatory tightening; Inovance is seeking clarification. There is no current restriction on e-axle imports, and more clarity is expected in about one quarter.

qa_highlights.question: What is the export growth outlook and the gross margin trend?
qa_highlights.answer: Exports rose to INR 228 crores from INR 141 crores, and new business of about INR 400 crores is in the pipeline. Gross margin is diluted by commodity pass-through (~0.4%) and lower-margin electronics, but EBITDA margin is expected to hold given better asset turns.

risks_watch: Inovance JV: China approval pending after tighter technology-partnership rules; possible delay to JV-linked e-drive and EV product launches.
Commodity and gas inflation could persist through FY27, keeping margins under the 11% target until pass-throughs catch up.
JV and associate profit was flat at INR 48 crores, and management expects recovery from Q2 as commodity prices are passed through.
Execution on the INR 2,000 crore capex balance over the next 18-24 months, plus ramp-up of new plants (Bawal, Kharkhoda, sunroof, Sambhajinagar seating).
Green mobility traction-motor volumes are small (2 OEMs), so the segment's profitability path is still unproven.
summary.management_tone: Confident on demand and growth, with a bullish tone on seating, sunroofs and EV. Cautious on near-term margins, which management attributes to commodity and wage costs; it hedged on Inovance and gave no volume figures for EV programs.
